summary.text: Louise Secker is the Republican candidate for the Missouri House of Representatives, District 161, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces Democrat Aaron Metzger.
Secker lost the August 4, 2026 Republican primary to Thomas Ross by 1,586 votes to 1,555 but was selected as the Republican nominee after Ross withdrew from the race, according to Ballotpedia.
